mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns remain positive in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate in two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) rising above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the trigger fires but no return decline follows for three consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below -1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings visibility and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or INDPRO recovers without a corresponding return rebound.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% signals a tightening monetary regime with accelerating inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with high inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the trigger fires but returns are flat for three consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures per capita (RSAFS divided by PAYEMS) exceeding 1% for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the trigger fires but returns are flat for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which pressure corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the trigger fires but returns are flat for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings visibility and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or INDPRO recovers without a corresponding return rebound.
